owns: UI working copies, save/discard/conflict presentation and safe Undo availability
Ticket/Objective/Inventory/Infrastructure workbench composition and cross-pane state preservation
does_not_own: domain command validity or lifecycle transitions
authority_rule: UI presents owning-domain facts and invokes owning-domain commands. A visible control, loaded row, selection, typed text, drag/drop, hold completion, dialog acceptance or recovered working copy never by itself creates authoritative domain state.
workbench_boundary: Workbenches are focused operational surfaces rather than disconnected command dialogs.
Wide layouts may use split working/evidence panes; narrow layouts preserve both through switchable panes/drawers/stacks.
Canonical Communication content remains owned by HLD-10 and is never copied into ticket records merely for display.
Domain-specific tab order/content is a presentation specialization over shared HLD-11 interaction primitives.
